pages.text: **Fuels are data.** Each file in *data/<pack>/fieldframe/fuels/* lists entries such as engine *fieldframe:fluid_engine*, fluid *minecraft:lava*, rf_per_mb 50; or engine *fieldframe:gem_engine*, item *#c:gems/diamond*, rf 400000. Later packs override earlier ones; a broken file is skipped and named in the server log.
